feeds.title: All things paper
feeds.description: Ann Martin's All Things Paper explores creative paper art and paper craft. She wants you to be inspired to look at paper in a new light.

feeds.title: Quilling Lady
feeds.description: Monika have been crafting for over 12 years now. She loves all sorts of having fun with paper like quilling, decoupage, box making, but my real passion is card making.

feeds.title: Red Ted Art
feeds.description: Red Ted Art is your one stop shop for crafts, be it to find craft activities for kids or tutorials for adults. The aim of this site is to provide easy, do-able and fun crafts for all ages.

feeds.title: Honey's Quilling
feeds.description: Honey's Quilling provides quality paper quilling paper, tools, kits, and other fun supplies. Follow this blog for paper quilling tutorials, tips, resources, how to make paper quilled jewelry, which supplies to use and more.

feeds.title: The Papery Craftery
feeds.description: I'm Meredith, art school grad and mama of two awesome and incredibly energetic littles. I fell across paper quilling by chance and fell in love with all the amazing things paper can do! Follow along as I roll tiny quilling creations and I promise I'll teach you every thing I know!

feeds.title: Paper Zen
feeds.description: A blog about paper quilling, SVG cutting, and hand-cut printables. Authored by Cecelia Louie.

feeds.title: Lantee Quilling
feeds.description: Lantee Quilling shares all the things about paper quilling include quilling ideas, quilling patterns, quilling tutorial, quilling artists etc.

feeds.title: Priya's Quilling
feeds.description: Priya is a stay at home mom who loves crafts n quilling. She is a Proud DT Member at IQCG (Indian Quilling Challenge Group). This blog is about her handmade Crafts, Paper Quilling, Mixed Media Art, Altered Art.

feeds.title: Serene Waves
feeds.description: Gayatri is working as a Senior Software Engineer now and in her spare hours she indulge herself in various forms of arts. 'Quilling' is one of those. Crafting makes her soul happy and it keeps her mind busy so it doesn't becomes a devil's workshop.

feeds.title: Shivani Creations
feeds.description: I am Shivani and I'm passionate about art..I have created this blog to share my projects with all art and craft lovers. I was software engineer by profession before but now turned completely in world of art.

feeds.title: Archana's Quilling Art
feeds.description: Archana's Quilling Art is her beautiful quilling art gallery where she shares all her quilling creations and ideas. In quilling you can use your own creativity and your own designs.

feeds.title: Quill Me
feeds.description: I have been a quiller for over 25 years. 'Quill Me' is an invitation to feel inspired and quill.

feeds.title: Crafty Wizard Blog
feeds.description: Crafty Wizard specialises in quilling paper and quilling supplies and paper crafts. They are an online service for crafters who would like to enjoy unbeatable pricing, quality products and friendly service.

feeds.title: Quilling Wonderland
feeds.description: Designer and maker of unique handmade quilling cards.

feeds.title: Trupti's Craft
feeds.description: Trupti's Craft is a place where you can learn paper quilling, origami, string art etc.
